title: LEXAM: Benchmarking Legal Reasoning on 340 Law Exams
reasoning: The benchmark includes specific subsets of law exam questions focused on 'Recht und Religion' (Law and Religion), 'Gegenwartsprobleme der politischen Ethik' (Contemporary Problems of Political Ethics), and 'Rechtsphilosophie' (Legal Philosophy), directly evaluating LLM performance on these ethical and religious-legal subdomains.
